description: Assistente di farmacia AFC at Amavita (Galenica Group), located in Balerna, Centro Breggia, Via S. Gottardo 56a, Canton Ticino, Switzerland. Galenica is the leading Swiss healthcare group and operates the largest pharmacy network in the country, with brands including Amavita, Sun Store, and Coop Vitality. This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, patient-oriented environment with excellent career development prospects.
